breaks.label: International break — September/October
breaks.notes: New 16-day merged window, up to 4 national-team matches. First time under FIFA's 2025-30 calendar — replaces the old separate September and October breaks. Blank domestic weekends: 26-27 Sep and 3-4 Oct.

breaks.label: International break — November
breaks.notes: Nations League matchdays 5-6 and AFCON 2027 qualifiers. Blank domestic weekend: 14-15 Nov.

breaks.label: International break — March
breaks.notes: Nations League quarter-finals and promotion/relegation play-offs, plus AFCON qualifiers. Blank domestic weekend: 27-28 Mar.

breaks.label: International break — June
breaks.notes: Falls after both domestic seasons end (30 May) and after the Champions League final (5 Jun), so it causes no club disruption.

breaks.label: La Liga winter break
breaks.notes: No Spanish league football. Standing LaLiga-AFE agreement. The Premier League has NO equivalent break and plays right through — only a rule guaranteeing 60 hours between rounds.

breaks.label: Supercopa de Espana — Istanbul
breaks.notes: Moved out of Saudi Arabia and out of January (RFEF, 13 Aug 2026) because of the AFC Asian Cup. Causes La Liga postponements for the four clubs involved.

breaks.label: Premier League January gap (FA Cup third round)
breaks.notes: Projected, not officially confirmed. Expected to be filled by the FA Cup third round.
